Package io.github.janglada.orkit.jobshop

Class JobShopBuilder

java.lang.Object
io.github.janglada.orkit.jobshop.JobShopBuilder
All Implemented Interfaces:
CpSatProblem<JobShopSchedule>, OptimizationProblem<JobShopSchedule>
public final class JobShopBuilder extends Object implements CpSatProblem<JobShopSchedule>
Fluent builder for job shop problems. Entry point: Optimize.jobShop().

  • Method Details

    • machines

      public JobShopBuilder machines(String... machineIds)
      Registers one or more machines that operations can be scheduled on.

    • machine

      public JobShopBuilder machine(String id, int capacity)
      Registers a machine that runs up to capacity operations at the same time, such as a bank of identical ovens. Capacity 1 is the same as machines(String...). Sequence-dependent setup times are not supported on a machine with capacity above 1.

    • startingAt

      public JobShopBuilder startingAt(LocalDateTime origin)
      Anchors model time 0 at origin, so operations may use LocalDateTime and Duration values (OperationConfig.takes(Duration), OperationConfig.releaseAt(LocalDateTime) and friends) and the schedule reports wall-clock times. One model unit is one minute unless timeUnit(Duration) says otherwise. Must be called before any job is declared.

    • timeUnit

      public JobShopBuilder timeUnit(Duration unit)
      Sets the length of one model time unit for calendar inputs; default one minute. Values that are not whole multiples of it are rejected. Requires startingAt(LocalDateTime) and must be called before any job is declared.

    • precedence

      public JobShopBuilder precedence(String beforeJob, String afterJob)
      Requires job beforeJob to finish before job afterJob starts: the last operation of the first ends before the first operation of the second starts. Jobs may be declared later; cycles are rejected when the problem is built.

    • precedence

      public JobShopBuilder precedence(String beforeJob, int beforeOp, String afterJob, int afterOp)
      Requires operation beforeOp of beforeJob to end before operation afterOp of afterJob starts (0-based indices). Cycles are rejected when the problem is built.

    • job

      public JobShopBuilder job(String id, Consumer<JobConfig> config)
      Adds a job to the schedule, configuring its ordered operations inside the supplied lambda via JobConfig.

    • setupTime

      public JobShopBuilder setupTime(String fromType, String toType, int units)
      Adds a global sequence-dependent setup time applied on every machine when an operation of fromType is followed by one of toType. Asymmetric pairs must be declared separately.

    • setupTimeOn

      public JobShopBuilder setupTimeOn(String machine, String fromType, String toType, int units)
      Adds a machine-specific setup time override, taking precedence over the global matrix on that machine.

    • defaultSetupTime

      public JobShopBuilder defaultSetupTime(int units)
      Sets the default setup time applied to any unlisted transition between two different typed operations. Not applied to untyped or same-type ops.

    • initialTypeOn

      public JobShopBuilder initialTypeOn(String machine, String type)
      Declares the type a machine held before the horizon, so the first operation on that machine pays a setup if its type differs.

    • downtime

      public JobShopBuilder downtime(String machine, long from, long to)
      Declares that machine is unavailable during [from, to) (maintenance, a shift break). Repeatable; overlapping windows on one machine are merged. Operations are non-preemptive, so none may straddle a downtime window.

    • downtime

      public JobShopBuilder downtime(String machine, LocalDateTime from, LocalDateTime to)
      Machine downtime as wall-clock times; requires startingAt(LocalDateTime). See downtime(String, long, long).

    • goal

      public JobShopBuilder goal(JobShopGoal goal)
      Sets the optimization objective. The default Goals.minimizeMakespan() preserves historical behavior. Use Goals.minimizeTardiness(long) or Goals.minimizeMakespanAndTardiness(long, long) to penalize soft due dates (set per operation via OperationConfig.dueBy(long)).
